subject: Discovery recap + quickstart plan for pilot with NexShift
message_1_subject: Discovery recap + quickstart plan for pilot with NexShift
message_1_body:
Hi Samira / Tom —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap of the problem and the pilot we discussed so we’re aligned before we kick off: 

Pain points we heard:
- High latency and unpredictable cost on inference for conversational search across large proprietary datasets.
- Inconsistent relevance for domain-specific prompts when model is run at scale.
- Need audit trail for responses and token-level cost attribution for finance.

Pilot goals (30 days):
1) Reduce median response latency for web search assistant by 40% under production-like load.
2) Demonstrate a 2x reduction in per-token cost for your top-10 prompt family using batching + prefix caching.
3) Establish a prompt-eval suite (50 seed prompts) and a quality baseline for regression monitoring.

Scope & success criteria (high level):
- Environment: staging dataset and 100K token/day simulated traffic (we'll use the access matrix you provide).
- Deliverables: tuned model variant, batching/cache config, prompt suite + eval results, onboarding doc for your SREs.
- Owners: Irene (sales, pilot PO), Ben (solutions/ops), Jordan (customer success).

Immediate asks from NexShift to get started:
- Provide S3 staging read-only path or a secure SFTP link for 2 sample datasets.
- Add "pilot-team@nexshift.ai" to your SSO (we'll send SAML metadata) or provide a service account for API access.
- Confirm a target kickoff week; we suggested Apr 20 — is that workable?

Attachments: I’ve attached a draft pilot scope (nexshift_pilot_scope_v1.pdf), an access matrix template (access_matrix.csv), and example prompts to seed the eval (prompt_suite_examples.md).

If this matches your understanding, please reply with confirmation and any edits. Happy to run a 15-min pre-kickoff tech check before we start.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0193

message_3_subject: Re: Discovery recap + quickstart plan for pilot with NexShift
message_3_body:
Thanks — looping in a couple operational notes before kickoff: 

- Jordan, can you be CS owner for runbooks and be first responder for the pilot (alerts + daily syncs)?
- Ops needs: please request the IAM ARNs Samira mentioned and a sample of the dataset file names so we can pre-provision a read-only ingestion job.
- Baseline telemetry: we’ll capture token-level cost, latencies (p50/p95), and top prompt failure modes. I’ll add the telemetry dashboard to the RED-3124 ticket.

Quick check: do we want to enable client-side prefix caching (low risk) for the pilot or keep full comparisons first? My recommendation: enable caching for two prompt families to show cost delta quickly, but run raw baseline for the rest.

—Ben
